#![allow(deprecated)]
use chrono::{FixedOffset, NaiveDate, TimeZone, Utc};
fn main() {
    let offset = FixedOffset::east_opt(19_800).unwrap();
    let datetime = offset.with_ymd_and_hms(2024,2,29,23,45,6).single().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(datetime.to_string(), "2024-02-29 23:45:06 +05:30");
    let naive = NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(2024,2,29).unwrap();
    let date = offset.from_local_date(&naive).single().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(date.to_string(), "2024-02-29+05:30");
    let utc = datetime.with_timezone(&Utc);
    assert_eq!(utc.timestamp(),datetime.timestamp());
    println!("{} {} {}",date,datetime,utc);
    println!("{}",datetime.format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %:z"));
}
